subject: ZenForge implementation orientation & owner assignment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Lin <emma.lin@zenforge.com>, Carlos Diaz <c.diaz@zenforge.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZenForge implementation orientation & owner assignment

Hi Tessa / Monica —

Quick context and ask: ZenForge (Therapeutics) executed a Dedicated contract today (deal ZF-2027-09-8721). Target go-live: 2027-11-10. They are moving sensitive PII through inference pipelines and require VPC private deployment with KMS integration and 30-day audit log retention.

Why this thread: outline initial implementation orientation, call out immediate blockers, and assign the primary CSM and implementation lead.

What Sales is handing off (summary):
- Primary contact: Emma Lin (Head of ML Ops) — cc'd.
- Technical contact: Carlos Diaz (Platform Eng) — cc'd.
- Key requirements: VPC peering, egress restriction, customer-managed KMS keys, SOC2 artifacts, production SLA 99.9% for inference.
- Initial traffic profile: 5k reqs/day, 1.5k concurrent tokens bursts (predictable daytime spike) — see attached traffic sketch.
- Billing/contract notes: 12-month reserved Dedicated GPUs (1 cluster). Finance agreed to monthly invoicing.

Immediate open items (pre-implementation):
1) Network: confirm CIDR ranges and peering window w/ infra partner.
2) KMS: confirm key owner and account linkage; client requires HSM-backed key.
3) SOW alignment: they requested a short change to maintenance window wording (see SOW v1.2).
4) Data handling: confirm data retention and log redaction policy.

Proposed owners:
- CSM (primary): Tessa Morgan — ownership for adoption, QBRs, and escalation.
- Implementation lead: Monica Patel — runbooks, go-live checklist, tech coordination.

Next steps: can you both confirm you can take these owners? Tessa — please suggest a 30/45/60-day success-plan outline (bullet list) and an initial kickoff with Emma & Carlos next week. Monica — please reach out to partners+infra@cloudbridge.io to schedule the network window and drop a list of required IPs.

Attachments: ZenForge_SOW_v1.2.pdf, zenforge_mop_v0.9.xlsx, zenforge_network_checklist.md

Thanks — I can join the kickoff if helpful.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Lin <emma.lin@zenforge.com>, Carlos Diaz <c.diaz@zenforge.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZenForge implementation orientation & owner assignment

Thanks Karthik — happy to own CSM. Emma / Carlos — nice to meet you by email.

Proposed 30/45/60-day success outline (high level):
- Day 0–14: Kickoff & access provisioning (confirm SSO, KMS owner, network windows).
- Day 15–30: Staging deployment & smoke tests (latency/cost baseline, model pinning).
- Day 31–45: Pilot with production traffic subset, QoS adjustments (batching, KV caching).
- Day 46–60: Full cutover runbook, rollback triggers, SLA verification.

A few clarifying Qs for Sales/ZenForge:
1) Are there regulatory controls requiring data residency in a particular US region?
2) Are they planning to bring their own HSM provider or use AWS CloudHSM (we need account-level contact)?
3) Any non-standard uptime windows (e.g., scheduled daily maintenance windows outside our default policy)?

I'm available for a 30-min kickoff slot Thursday 09/30 10:00–11:00 PT or Friday 10/01 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works for Emma & Carlos?

Also tagging Monica: Monica, can you ingest the network checklist and confirm whether the requested CIDR range overlaps any known reserved pools?

Thanks,
—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners+infra@cloudbridge.io, Carlos Diaz <c.diaz@zenforge.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ZenForge implementation orientation & owner assignment

Acknowledged — I'll take implementation lead. Quick notes after a first pass on the network checklist: 
- Requested CIDR 10.100.0.0/16 looks clear from our end; will validate with CloudBridge today.
- Need client AWS account ID for peering; Carlos, please share the account ID and the KMS key ARN.
- We should schedule the peering and routing change during a low-traffic maintenance window — propose 10/20 02:00–05:00 PT as an initial option, pending ZenForge approval.

On the MOP spreadsheet: I suggested a row for "observability hooks" — we want to ensure they surface token-level cost on their side as well to align thresholds.

Internal note (do not forward): Sales approved a one-time onboarding credit capped at $15k for ramp — we should bake that into the finance handoff doc.

I'll reach out to partners+infra@cloudbridge.io to get the peering calendar and will update the shared Drive link.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lin <emma.lin@zenforge.com>, Carlos Diaz <c.diaz@zenforge.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: ZenForge kickoff — proposed time and docs

Emma / Carlos — thanks for the quick replies. Per Tessa & Monica's availability, propose kickoff: Friday 2027-10-01 at 14:00 PT. Please confirm or propose an alternate.

Immediate asks for kickoff agenda:
- Introductions & ownership (5m)
- Security/compliance overview (KMS, SOC2 artifacts) (10m)
- Network peering schedule & CIDR confirmation (Monica + CloudBridge) (10m)
- Staging deployment plan & smoke tests (Monica) (10m)
- Success metrics & go/no-go criteria (Tessa) (10m)
- Next steps & MOP checkpoints (5m)

Attachments for review before kickoff: ZenForge_SOW_v1.2.pdf (SOW w/ minor clause change), zenforge_mop_v0.9.xlsx (deployment plan), zenforge_network_checklist.md.

Carlos — could you share the AWS account ID and KMS ARN in a reply-all? If you prefer not to post keys here, feel free to send to monica.patel@redwood.ai directly.

Looking forward — Karthik

[Attachment stubs]
- ZenForge_SOW_v1.2.pdf (PDF)
- zenforge_mop_v0.9.xlsx (Excel)
- zenforge_network_checklist.md (Markdown)
